bid.buyer: Ministry of Defence / Department of Military Affairs
bid.reason: The tender is for the procurement of physical hardware (kamikaze drones, batteries, servos) with embedded AI modules for surveillance, not for an enterprise AI software platform or MLOps services.

evidence.quote: 10 INCH DIFFERENT KAMIKAZE DRONE... FRAME... STACK... BRUSHLESS MOTORS... PROPELLERS... RECEIVER... AI MODULE... BATTERY... SERVO... DROP MECH... OFC SPOOL... GOGGLES... 3D PRINTED ATTACHMENTS
AI MODULE... Dual visible-light camera system for enhanced target detection. AI-based automatic target locking and dynamic tracking. Supports recognition of multiple targets simultaneously.
15-Inch Long Range UAV Platform... Integrated Thermal + Day Vision Camera System... Stable GPS Assisted Autonomous Flight... Real-Time FPV & Telemetry Transmission

key_facts.scope_summary: Supply of 125 AI-enabled kamikaze drones and associated hardware components.
